"Mr. Kershner, who has been working for the American Friends' Service Committee as Director of Relief in Europe... described to me what is perhaps the most ghastly thing in war—the unbearable tragedy of growing children who lose weight every week, who develop tuberculosis and rickets, who faint with hunger at school, whose legs become sticks and whose bellies swell into drums."
"New Statesman and Nation", 6th Feb., 1943.

BUILDING A HEALTHY RACE
